title: Attach screenshots to ask prompts
notes: ask --image <path> attaches 1–10 PNG, JPG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF images up to 20 MB each, waits for uploads before sending, and directs image files passed to --file to use --image.
ask confirms that the prompt has started sending before it waits for an answer.
setup reports whether ChatGPT is logged in after the browser bridge connects.
